flowContents.name: PDF_OCR_Trino_SemanticSearch_Pipeline
flowContents.comments: Ingests multipage PDFs via HTTPS POST to OCR, routes structured fields to Trino, and indexes chunked free text into Trino and Cloudera Semantic Search.

properties.groovyx-script-body:
import groovy.json.JsonSlurper
import groovy.json.JsonOutput
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets

def flowFile = session.get()
if (!flowFile) return

def indexName = flowFile.getAttribute('css.index.name') ?: 'pdf_document_chunks'
int chunkSize = 1500
int overlap = 200

try {
    def payload = null
    session.read(flowFile, { inputStream ->
        payload = new JsonSlurper().parse(inputStream, 'UTF-8')
    } as org.apache.nifi.processor.io.InputStreamCallback)

    def ndjson = new StringBuilder()
    def blocks = payload?.free_text_blocks ?: []

    blocks.each { block ->
        String text = (block.text ?: '').trim()
        if (!text) return
        int start = 0
        int chunkIdx = 0
        while (start < text.length()) {
            int end = Math.min(start + chunkSize, text.length())
            String chunkText = text.substring(start, end)
            def actionMeta = JsonOutput.toJson([index: [_index: indexName]])
            def docBody = JsonOutput.toJson([
                document_id     : payload.document_id,
                source_filename : payload.source_filename,
                ingest_timestamp: payload.ingest_timestamp,
                page_number     : block.page_number,
                section_heading : block.section_heading,
                chunk_index     : chunkIdx,
                chunk_text      : chunkText
            ])
            ndjson.append(actionMeta).append("\n").append(docBody).append("\n")
            if (end == text.length()) break
            start += (chunkSize - overlap)
            chunkIdx++
        }
    }

    flowFile = session.write(flowFile, { outputStream ->
        outputStream.write(ndjson.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
    } as org.apache.nifi.processor.io.OutputStreamCallback)

    flowFile = session.putAttribute(flowFile, 'mime.type', 'application/x-ndjson')
    session.transfer(flowFile, REL_SUCCESS)
} catch (Exception e) {
    log.error('Failed to chunk free text blocks for Semantic Search', e)
    session.transfer(flowFile, REL_FAILURE)
}
